name: OpenTelemetry Collector
description: Installs the OpenTelemetry Collector core or contrib distribution and runs it as an s6-overlay service.

version.description: OpenTelemetry Collector release version to install. `latest` installs the newest stable release containing the selected distribution.

distribution.description: Official OpenTelemetry Collector distribution to install: `core` or `contrib`.

serviceUser.description: User account that runs the Collector. Automatic selection prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.
